opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit granted, limited to the question whether the Circuit Court of Appeals should have reversed the judgment of conviction because of the refusal of the trial court to grant Instruction B requested by the defendant.
